notes: GOLD v1 (gold fixer round 1, 2026-10-18), from the label_lines_r3 pairs for this CONSUMED staged scan (23553000 PARTIAL_SCAN_2, t 0.92 mm). 9 bends are formed in this stage: on each arm's top end a plate-to-slope fold (~60 deg) and a V-bottom fold (~118 deg); on each arm's bottom end a return lip (~119 deg); the root of the arched hanging tab at the window edge (90 deg); and the two joggle folds (plate to offset wall 7, and wall 7 to recessed panel 3; 90 deg each). The other 7 CAD bend lines are not formed yet: the arms and the main plate are flat apart from smooth warp of 2 deg or less, with no kink. Three auditors and the fixer's own sections agree on all 9 bends. Only B3 was off: its planes and apex are on the inner (bottom) skin, because the right arm's top skin is not scanned from v~80 mm to the tip. B3 needs a 1.2 mm outward shift along -bisector onto the unscanned outer apex. The current tool cannot express that shift; the proposed outer_shift_mm override is pending owner approval (see the B3 note). B1-B2 and B4-B9 are unchanged and on the outer apex. Not bends: hole and window walls, perimeter and thickness edges, thin strip 18 (an outer-arc facet of the tab root), noise patch 19, and the top-skin dropout squares on the left end, the right arm and the right end.

bends.note: left arm top end: plate-to-slope fold (~60 deg bend, outer skin = top skin). The global plate patch is one plane over the warped 487x236 sheet, so near the arm end the plate skin is >0.41 mm off it. The plate side is therefore a local plane seeded on the arm skin ~10 mm from the fold.
left arm top end: V-bottom fold, slope to upturned flange (~118 deg bend, outer skin = bottom skin)

right arm top end: plate-to-slope fold (~60 deg bend), the mirror twin of B1. GOLD LOCUS NOT REACHABLE WITH THE CURRENT TOOL: the arm's top (outer) skin is not scanned from v~80 mm to the tip, so both sides are inner (bottom) skin planes and this line lands on the INNER apex. The gold outer apex is 1.2 mm outward along -bisector (0.088, 0.071, 0.994). Evidence: on B1 the scanned outer-to-inner apex gap is 1.2-1.3 mm (stations 10-90%). Mapping the left arm's top skin onto the right arm by 2-D ICP on the bottom skins (median residual 0.024 mm) puts the right arm's outer skin 1.19-1.21 mm above this inner apex, with its vertex ~0.3 mm lateral. The thickness alone, t=0.92 (concentric arcs), is the lower bound. A proposed additive lines.py override, outer_shift_mm, was tested off-tree on this scan: B3 moved exactly 1.2 mm, no scan points within 0.3 mm of the shifted line, and the other 8 bends were byte-identical. Adding "outer_shift_mm": 1.2 here needs that override and the owner's approval. The plate side is a local plane seeded ~10 mm from the fold, because the global plate patch is >0.41 mm off the warped sheet near the arm end.
right arm top end: V-bottom fold, slope to upturned flange (~118 deg bend, outer skin = bottom skin, which is the only skin scanned here)

left arm bottom end: return lip fold (~119 deg bend, outer skin = top skin). The leg's later foot fold is not formed in this stage. The plate side is a local plane seeded on the arm skin ~10 mm from the fold, because the global plate patch is >0.41 mm off the warped sheet near the arm end.

right arm bottom end: return lip fold (~119 deg bend, outer skin = top skin). The plate side is a local plane seeded on the arm skin ~10 mm from the fold, because the global plate patch is >0.41 mm off the warped sheet near the arm end.

root of the arched hanging tab at the window edge (90 deg), full tab width ~79 mm. The planes are fit to the inner-skin patches (plate bottom 1, tab face 5), but the apex search lands on the outer skin. The line sits on the outer apex where that apex is scanned (10%, 75%); in between, the inner arc is 0.93-1.0 mm below it.

joggle upper fold: plate to offset wall 7 (90 deg). The planes are fit to the inner-skin patches (plate bottom 1, wall face 7), but the label lands on the outer apex, with the inner arc 0.92-1.05 mm below it. The line spans the full wall width (~61 mm), and the relief notches at its ends lie inside that span.
joggle lower fold: offset wall 7 to recessed panel 3 (90 deg, outer skin)
